method_note: Two independent human adjudicators — Atanas (pass A) and Stoyan (pass B) — labelling the same frozen assignments, each blinded to the other's pass, to the v1 labels, to the analysis files and to the clean-amplification stratum. This is the plan's option (a), the strongest of the three and the one the gate assumes; it is NOT the solo fallback (b). It measures INTER-RATER AGREEMENT, and every report derived from it must say so under that name — reporting it as `rubric stability` would under-claim a stronger result. The seven-day gap does not apply and its absence is not a weakening: the gap exists only to decorrelate ONE person's two passes from their own memory of the first, and two people share no such memory. The scorer derives the method from the sealed passes' adjudicator names and rejects a policy that disagrees with them, so this field cannot be used to claim a method the passes do not support.

supplements.paths_note: Completed passes live in the gitignored news/var/adjudication/ working tree, per the workspace's refusal to write inside news/evals/ — the checked-in templates are the frozen input and must stay pending.

exemptions.reason: Not exercised by design. Every row in the main sample is keyed on an (article, party_surface) pair, so every article carries a party the outlet named and is political by construction — leaning `not_applicable` means no political dimension at all (a weather forecast, a football result), which this sample cannot contain. On v1's reading of these same 50 articles the category appears twice, so Cohen kappa on it is dominated by one or two cells: a dry run returned 0.6479 off THREE disagreements with a bootstrap interval of the full [0.0, 1.0]. Blocking the cutover on that number would block it on noise. Widening is not available either: an article with no party pair cannot be an assignment row at all without changing the sample's unit.
exemptions.corroboration: Honoured ONLY while the category stays unexercised (minority_n below min_minority_n). If the adjudicator marks enough leaning `not_applicable` for the measure to become scorable, the exemption is REFUSED and the measure scores normally — a B4 regression must not be switchable off by policy.
exemptions.what_is_not_exempt: leaning.direction is scored in full, and russia_stance.applicability is scored in full. This exemption covers exactly one measure on one axis.

method_history.reason: Recorded as the solo fallback (b) because no second adjudicator was available on 2026-09-01. Superseded before any pass B was sealed: a second human (Stoyan) took both pass B files, so the gate ran under option (a) and no measurement was ever made under the fallback.
